en.title: Turn goals into daily actions.
en.intro: Break a goal into concrete work, fit it into your available time, and begin with one action.
en.name_note: The current app is labelled franklin-goal. This is its Frankie repository introduction.
en.concept_title: Connect the goal, the work and the day.
en.concept_intro: The workspace connects three different decisions: what you want, what work it requires, and when you can actually do it.
concepts: A goal keeps its purpose and summary. Phases group the work; steps describe actions, research, preparation or milestones, with estimated effort. A step can open an existing child breakdown or be broken down further.

Daily planning follows the existing breakdown, including linked child plans. Actions retain their source path, completion criterion and prerequisites, so a small task still points back to its original purpose.

The time page surfaces one unfinished action whose date and prerequisites permit it. Previously started work takes priority. “Start with 5 minutes” records a start; it is not a countdown and does not mark the task complete.
en.planning_title: Plan the next stretch, not an ideal future.
en.planning_intro: Choose dates, weekdays, daily focused minutes and an action-size limit. You can add current circumstances and a definition of progress, but they are optional.
modes: Arrange a feasible first stage. Work that does not fit stays in the goal with an explanation, alongside an expected outcome and a review date.
Try to fit the whole remaining scope into the chosen period. If the work or prerequisites cannot fit, the app reports the issue instead of quietly shortening the effort estimate.
en.planning_note: AI proposes actions; the scheduler checks dates, capacity and prerequisite order. Existing commitments and completed actions consume daily capacity. Review and edit the preview before applying it. Applying a new plan replaces this goal’s unfinished schedule and preserves completed actions.
en.manual_intro: The manual route is fully usable: create a goal, add a step with an effort estimate, open “手动安排单个原始步骤”, choose a date, and add it to the schedule. You do not need to generate a whole plan first.
steps: Describe an outcome and useful constraints. Choose manual creation, or use AI breakdown when the server has OpenRouter configured.
Read the phases and steps. For manual goals, add an action. For generated plans, review the scope and open smaller breakdowns where needed.
Schedule a step manually, or request a daily-plan preview with realistic availability. Applying the preview writes it to your local schedule.
Open Time planning. Start one eligible action, mark it complete when it is done, or stop and return later. Completed progress is not reset by a missed session.
captions: Goal entry and the manual route, before adding sample data.
Daily planning settings for a manually created sample goal. No AI plan was requested.
The real next-action screen after scheduling a sample step.
The focused start state. Starting is separate from completing.
The expandable calendar groups time into quarters, months, weeks and days.
en.storage: Goals, schedules, time-block notes and preferences are saved in this browser. There is no account or cross-device sync. Another browser or app address has its own records; clearing browser data can remove them.
en.ai: AI breakdown and daily planning call the app’s server, which sends goal/planning context to OpenRouter. The deployment owner configures a server-side key and compatible model. The app does not ask visitors to paste a key. Manual creation, scheduling and notes do not need an AI request.
en.backup: Export a JSON backup before changing browsers or importing data. A full workspace backup replaces goals, schedules and planner notes; planner-only data replaces the planner; supported goal-only files add plans with conflicting IDs remapped. The import dialog confirms replacement. Files are limited to 10 MB.
en.notes_title: A calendar with room for notes
en.notes: Expand the time calendar to inspect quarter, month, week and day blocks. Edit a block’s notes, status or tags and see scheduled actions on the corresponding day. This is a local planning workspace, not a connected external calendar.
en.run_note: Start the Next.js app after installing dependencies. Configure OPENROUTER_API_KEY and a compatible OPENROUTER_MODEL on the server only if you want AI features. AI estimates and expected outcomes still need your review; they are not evidence that work is complete.
en.footer: A Frankie project by Songhai Fan

zh.title: 让目标，变成每天的行动。
zh.intro: 把目标拆成具体工作，放进真实可用的时间，再从一个行动开始。
zh.name_note: 当前应用界面名为 franklin-goal；此页面是它的 Frankie 仓库介绍。
zh.concept_title: 连接目标、工作，与真实的一天。
zh.concept_intro: 这个工作区把三个不同的问题连接起来：想达到什么、需要做哪些事，以及何时真的有时间做。
concepts: 目标 → 阶段 → 步骤
目标保留目的和摘要；阶段整理工作；步骤记录行动、研究、准备或里程碑及预计用时。一个步骤可以继续拆小，也可以打开已有的子拆解。
每日规划沿用现有拆解，包括已经关联的子计划。行动保留来源路径、完成标准和前置条件，拆小之后仍能看出它为什么存在。
每日行动 → 真正开始
时间规划页只突出一个已到日期、前置条件满足的未完成行动，并优先续接已经开始的工作。“先做 5 分钟”记录开始，不是倒计时，也不会自动勾选完成。
zh.planning_title: 先安排下一段，而不是理想中的全部未来。
zh.planning_intro: 设置起止日期、可安排的星期、每天专注分钟数与行动颗粒度。也可补充现状和进展标准；不清楚时仍然可以先开始。
modes: 先安排本期可行的一段。放不下的工作仍保留在目标里，并说明原因，同时记录本期预期成果和复盘日期。
尝试在所选时间内完成全部剩余范围。如果工作量或前置条件放不下，应用会说明问题，而不是悄悄缩短工作估时。
zh.planning_note: AI 提出行动，排程逻辑检查日期、容量与前置顺序。其他目标的安排和已完成行动会占用当天额度。应用前先审阅、修改预览；重新应用会替换本目标未完成的日程，保留已完成项。
zh.manual_intro: 可以手动创建目标，添加行动及预计用时，展开“手动安排单个原始步骤”，选好日期并加入日程。不需要先生成一整份计划。
steps: 描述想达到的结果和实际限制。可以手动创建；服务端配置好 OpenRouter 后，也可以让 AI 拆解。
阅读阶段和步骤。手动目标可直接添加行动；生成的计划则先检查范围，需要时继续拆小。
手动安排步骤，或按实际时间请求每日计划预览。确认应用后，预览才写入本地日程。
打开时间规划，先做一个满足条件的行动。做完再标记完成，也可以今天先到这里。错过一次安排不会清空已完成进度。

示例步骤加入日程后的“今天先做这一件”。

zh.storage_title: 本地记录，可选的在线规划。
zh.storage: 目标、日程、时间块笔记与偏好保存在当前浏览器，没有账号和跨设备同步。不同浏览器或应用地址拥有独立记录；清除浏览器数据可能删除它们。
zh.ai: AI 拆解与每日规划会调用应用服务端，再把目标及规划上下文发送到 OpenRouter。部署者配置服务端 key 和兼容模型；界面不要求访客粘贴 key。手动创建、安排日期和写笔记不需要 AI 请求。
zh.backup: 更换浏览器或导入前先导出 JSON 备份。完整工作区备份会替换目标、日程和时间块笔记；仅规划文件替换规划；兼容的仅目标文件会追加目标，并为冲突 ID 重新编号。导入对话框会确认替换，文件上限 10 MB。
zh.notes: 展开时间日历，查看季度、月、周、日的时间块。可编辑笔记、状态与标签，对应日期也能看到已安排的行动。这是本地规划工作区，没有连接外部日历。
zh.run_note: 安装依赖后启动 Next.js。只有需要 AI 功能时，才在服务端配置 OPENROUTER_API_KEY 与兼容的 OPENROUTER_MODEL。AI 的估时和预期成果仍需审阅，不代表工作已经完成。
zh.footer: Songhai Fan 的 Frankie 系列项目
